content.en: The **World Health Organization (WHO)** acts as the directing and coordinating authority on international health work. It plays a pivotal role in establishing **international health regulations**, monitoring disease outbreaks, and providing technical assistance to member states. In the context of the **Indian Economy**, WHO guidelines influence national health policies, pharmaceutical standards, and the allocation of resources within the **Union Budget** for public health initiatives.
